content:
maya: Quick reminder — changelog cutoff for the v0.9.2 release is in ~12h. If you have customer-visible or infra changes, drop a single-line entry here using keep-a-changelog style. No long prose, please.

sam: Got it. Will add my runtime patch. Do we also need a version bump PR or will CI handle it?

maya: CI will bump the package version on release, but add a note like `Changed: runtime: reduced KV cache flush frequency (#412)` so release notes are clear.

lee: quick Q — any specific prefix rules? I usually put `Added/Changed/Fixed/Security`.

maya: Yup those are the categories we prefer. If unsure, use `Changed`. Follow this small template:

lee: ```
### Added
- short sentence (PR link)
### Changed
- short sentence (PR link)
### Fixed
- short sentence (PR link)
```

grace: tagging a small formatting nit — please avoid long sentences and don't include internal-only debug details. The release notes get customer-facing.

sam: adding mine now: `Changed: runtime: reduce cold-start overhead for small batches (#417)`

devops-bot: Reminder: branch cutoff enforced at 2024-06-06T18:00Z. Any PRs merging after cutoff may be cherry-picked for point releases only.

maya: If you add entries, ping me here so I can aggregate and run the small changelog linter. I'll also run the release-notes formatter 30m before cutoff.

lee: ping @maya — I pushed a tiny fix entry: `Fixed: grpc endpoint healthcheck returning 500 on unexpected header (#419)`

maya: Seen — thanks. Two process reminders: 1) keep each entry to one line, 2) include PR number in parens.

grace: Any objections to grouping two small infra items under `Changed: infra:` so the section doesn't get crowded?

maya: Fine with grouping if the items are closely related — keep clarity for customers.

sam: One last thing — if you have screenshots or docs links, add them to the PR body, not the changelog entry.

maya: Perfect. I'll run the linter at 17:30Z and post the aggregated block for final sign-off. Thanks all :thumbsup:
